key_concepts: Blender tutorial showing how to use Geometry Nodes to create sugar coated candy.

content: A field is a function that is calculated at a particular point in space. What does that mean? Here is an example. In this shader, we have a [k]Geometry Node[/k] which passes the world position into a [k]Noise Texture Node[/k] (Image 1). If we grab the plane and move it in the x-xis, we see that the noise field stays still, meaning that as we move the plane, the underlying noise texture in a specific location is unchanged (Image 2). The noise is specifically being calculated at each location where the mesh has a point.
